scope: Architecture and contract only; no production, Docker, SCM/PR, selector, mapping, or item-8 policy implementation
storageInterfaceChangeRequired: Minimum backward-compatible evolution of the existing interface: vendor-neutral object result, typed outcomes, structured checksummed pointer, and explicit concurrency capability/result
validationServer: Nexus Repository OSS hosted RAW repository; validation infrastructure only
concurrencyModel: Item-5d ancestry decision inside a store coordination boundary; controller-wide keyed serialization is sufficient only for the first sole-writer single-controller topology; atomic remote CAS is required for multiple controllers or external writers
credentialModel: Persist credentialId only; resolve through Jenkins Credentials API at execution time and pass a short-lived authentication abstraction to the backend
credentialTypes: Jenkins Username/Password; repository token may be supplied as password when Basic authentication is supported
remotePathModel: Fixed projects/branches/revisions and pointers segments with existing safeComponent encoding for logical project, branch, and revision
nextTasks: TASK68 generic RAW HTTP backend + Docker Nexus RAW
TASK69 Jenkins credential integration + authenticated remote publish/lookup
